summary: BBVA filed a Form 6-K (foreign-issuer current report) notifying an agreed issuance of €1.0 billion nominal of preferred securities contingently convertible into newly issued ordinary shares, excluding pre-emptive subscription rights. The securities are expected to qualify as Additional Tier 1 capital, bear a 6.500% distribution from 18 November 2026 to 18 May 2034, then reset at the 5-year Mid-Swap Rate plus 333.4 bps. Directors' and independent expert reports were issued; closing expected 18 November 2026, with listing on Euronext Dublin's Global Exchange Market. A routine bank capital raise, not a special situation; watch AT1 pricing and conversion triggers.
